The branch was relaunched: it already carried three pushed commits from an earlier attempt of this same rung, plus an uncommitted report and probes. That work was verified rather than redone — the bytecode cache was wiped and rebuilt from scratch, and the test, every probe, the .test file through the harness and the after-ladder run were all re-run, all reproducing.
